options.description: Fastest: the strongest holder leads each area, no pairing.

options.description: Balanced: holders lead, a learner pairs on single-holder areas, nobody carries more than 2 areas.

assumptions.note: Recommendations for a manager to approve. Uses evidence of who knows what and HR dates only; never individual performance.
